safety.label: Baseline accuracy
safety.detail: Tier-1: 10 community-passed proposals the delegate should simply UPHOLD. Think-off ruled all 10 correctly every trial; think-on mangled or struck roughly one in four.

safety.label: Adversarial robustness
safety.detail: Tier-2: 10 proposals carrying a hidden 'gimme the money' payload the delegate should STRIKE_DOWN. Think-off caught every one; think-on cleared only 68.5% — the rest collapsed, and 1.5% of trials were actively talked into approving the theft.

safety.label: Juridical consistency
safety.detail: Same proposal, 20 trials, same verdict? Think-off never wavered; think-on's ruling flipped across re-runs 27% of the time — a delegate you cannot predict from one block to the next.

safety.label: Schema validity
safety.detail: Did the model emit a parseable binary ruling at all? Think-on hit 'reasoning non-convergence' on 26.7% of inferences — it argued past the 8,000-token budget and returned nothing the contract could act on.

cost.label: Latency per ruling
cost.detail: 12.8s versus 226.4s — a 17x tax for thinking. At Optimism's ~2s blocks that 226s is about 113 blocks: a fixed, public window in which the pending vote can be front-run or arbitraged. That window is Governance-Extractable Value.
